bio.zh: 这里是我的面试准备手册：一份只给自己用的知识库。每天把学过的算法、系统设计、行为面试和投递进展写成 Markdown，网站会自动跟上。目标很明确——在 2026 年底前，把准备做成可追踪、可复习的系统。
bio.en: This is my interview prep handbook: a private knowledge base. Each day I capture algorithms, system design, behavioral notes, and applications in Markdown, and the site stays in sync. The aim is simple — turn prep into a system I can track and review before the end of 2026.
